title: Use current mermaid version in docs.
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Replaces the plugin with custom code to handle mermaid.

Async rendering isn't working.
Revert a88a467d4569837f491e67a97f1a70ca570e087b to try async.

If anyone is interested in fixing this, please let me know, that'd be really helpful. 

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

We need this as we don't want the docs to lag behind the official release to showcase new features.

### :clipboard: Tasks

Make sure you

- [ ] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] :computer: have added unit/e2e tests (if appropriate)
- [ ] :bookmark: targeted `develop` branch
author: sidharthv96
